title: Measure indexed plan and radio-setting agreement
description:
Qualify production plan-index/mask translation to actual radio settings for the session-approved baseline or candidate plan. Consume finalized wire, independent corpus, full C integration and software compliance evidence. Do not duplicate their implementation or extend an existing plan ID silently.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching authority.10 and rf.03 approvals before any port or RF operation. The candidate 128-entry grid is not automatically enabled or covered. A closed gate or earlier configured session does not authorize this sweep; denied/mismatched scope leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Independent integer-Hz entries and mask vectors cover relevant 7/8, 15/16, 31/32, 63/64, 127/128 and sparse-set boundaries. Correlated settings and independent RF frequency observations prove tested translations. Unsupported or unauthorized upper indices remain disabled/unassessed; a compile or log alone is not RF proof.
